runs.name: Sands China Ltd.; HKEX 1928 and a US OTC ADR, ten shares per ADS, unsponsored; a Macao integrated-resort owner and operator through Venetian Macau Limited, one of six gaming concessionaires, with The Venetian, The Londoner, The Parisian, The Plaza and Sands Macao; 74.80% owned by Las Vegas Sands; not an SEC registrant since its 20-Fs ended in 2023; Wynn, MGM China and Melco read as named rivals through their parents' filings, Galaxy and SJM flagged
runs.box: TOO HARD (NATURE) AT Q1; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **HK$11.29** a share (1928.HK, 2026-10-14) and **US$14.28** an ADS (SCHYY, 2026-10-14), Yahoo chart through `tools/sources.price`, aggregator, flagged, ex the interim dividend; ten shares per ADS in all three depositary registrations on EDGAR (CIK 1491703; JPMorgan F-6EF 0001193805-19-001923, Deutsche Bank F-6 POS 0001193805-17-002601, BNY F-6EF 0001019155-11-000330), unsponsored. Shares **8,093,379,566**, no treasury shares (2025 Annual Report note 19; unchanged at 2026-06-30 in the 2026 Interim Report); Las Vegas Sands 74.80%; cap **US$11,654M** (HK$91,375M at 7.8406). Sovereign **5.56%**, the US Treasury 30-year par yield 2026-10-13, the group reporting in US dollars with revenue in patacas and HK dollars pegged to it (the earnings-currency reading recorded by the analyst as unclear). Filings read, from HKEXnews (document references and dates in place of accessions, the brief's departure): the 2025 Annual Report (2026-03-31), the 2026 Interim Report (2026-08-24), the 2024, 2022, 2020 and 2016 Annual Reports, and the XBRL of SCL's 20-Fs (CIK 1755281, last 0001755281-23-000018) for 2016 to 2022; one figure cross-checked (2020 operating cash US$(816)M in the statement against the FY2020 20-F XBRL; 2025's US$2,105M against the MD&A). `tools/run.py` and `cover_shares.py` refused, not an SEC filer; every figure by hand in `compute.py`. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the 2025 Annual Report's concession section, risk factors and MD&A (the brief's departure), stated in the run file. **Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE)**: casino 75% of 2025 net revenue of US$7,443M; VML's Concession expires 2032-12-31, inside the ten years, the gaming assets already reverted to the Macao government "without compensation" by deeds of 2022-12-30 and used for a fee, renewal and its terms set by a future tender, redemption possible from 2029-01-01; the 2022 tender added a 35.84bn pataca investment commitment, 33.39bn non-gaming, project by project with government approval; mainland visitation set by policy, revenue US$9,505M (2014) to US$6,820M (2015) and US$1,605M (2022), owner cash US$2,494M (2018) to US$(1,879)M (2020). Contrary evidence weighed at Q1 and recorded: all six incumbents re-awarded in 2022, the television-licence rows **[M2004-058]**, **[M2006-052]**, **[M2012-074]**, **[M2018-083]**. Facts after the stop, not weighed: the report names five rivals; Wynn, MGM China and Melco read from their parents' SEC filings, **Galaxy and SJM flagged, not SEC filers**; 2017 to 2019 against 2023 to 2025 Macao revenue Sands China -16.0%, Wynn -25.2%, Melco -18.6%, MGM China +61.3%; margins 35.4% to 32.6% against 30.2% to 30.6%, 27.0% to 26.4%, 25.6% to 27.1% (indicative, measures differ); share of the four's revenue 41.3% (2019) to 37.1% (2025). Integrity facts recorded, not judged: the LVS royalty of 1.5% of gross revenue (US$118M in 2025), the featured adjusted property EBITDA a basis for incentive pay, the AAEC claim of about US$11.93bn still open. Owner cash (US$M, after all spending, lease repayments, the gaming-licence fee and stock pay), 2016 to 2025 as paid: 1,177, 2,145, 2,494, 2,032, (1,879), (571), (749), 2,022, 1,147, 1,485; cycle base 2016 to 2025 **US$798M** at the statutory 12% tax, the exemption ending 2027 (US$930M as paid), 2021 the closures so the cycle sets the base; growth between the halves -10.64% a year, carried as the bottom; the literal 2021 to 2025 window US$580M, shown. Balance sheets 2015 to June 2026: assets US$10bn to 12bn throughout; equity US$5.8bn (2015) to a deficit of US$700M (2022) to US$1.3bn, first dividends of about US$2.05bn a year 2016 to 2019 above profit, then US$4.15bn of losses 2020 to 2022; borrowings peak US$10.2bn (2022), US$6.4bn at June 2026; net current liabilities US$849M at June 2026. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: net debt US$5,971M (leases out of net debt, their repayments inside owner cash, and the gaming-tax exemption to 2027 added as US$250M, both a CONVENTION of the run); value range **HK$0.55 to 8.37** a share (HK$5.48 to 83.71 per ADS) against HK$11.29, the price above the top; no case earns the floor (4.60% top, 1.67% bottom); fair **HK$0.27** a share all-equity (HK$2.75 per ADS), **HK$3.52** equity-only (HK$35.22 per ADS), not armed, the box being TOO HARD at Q1; beside: the phase growth -3.24% gives HK$5.23 to 8.37, fair HK$1.44; the Concession case, seven years and nothing after, HK$(1.16); the 2016 to 2019 phase carried flat for ever returns 10.02%, not a case of the range, recorded as the evidence most favourable to the name. Contamination declared by the analyst: the recent commit subjects carrying the GXYYY run and fold (another Macao concessionaire, its box, reason, rate, range and fair price), seen at both sessions' start; the box was written by the first session, and the rate and rivals were kept on the run's own reasons; other tickers' research-folder names in git status; the memory-index lines; none used. Write-early: the template copy (8761bad5), then Step 0, the foundations and Q1 committed together (0436fc8c) before the first session was killed at a limit or session end; **resumed 2026-10-15 by the overnight cycle with one dispatched analyst** (the resume paragraph of the cycle prompt), committing per section (3c9821ad, 2b0657ba, 642e563e); the resume filled three missing borrowings figures with a dated note and corrected the first session's M1997-109 quote in place with a dated note (words not the row's own), both visible in the run file. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `check_cites.py` clean, 30 ids, no E-id; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_citecheck.py` 21 quote-beside-id pairs, one flag on M2012-065 found on reading to be the M2000-037 quote ending within forty characters of the M2012-065 id; that quote is M2000-037's own words, so no slip. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) Q7 has no instruction for a right to earn that ends by contract inside ten years; (2) Q7 (a) against (b) where one cycle is read and the series changes sign, the halves rate measuring where the closures fall; (3) the three-to-one width test does not say business or per share (2.28 against 15.3 to one here); (4) Whose tax names no time-limited exemption; (5) net debt under IFRS 16, every lease inside borrowings; (6) the earnings currency for a US-dollar reporter earning in pegged currencies; (7) the template's accession rule for a name with no SEC filings. Could not get: Galaxy and SJM, a maintenance split from the mandated investment, owner cash for 2012 to 2015, Las Vegas Sands' own filings.
runs.narr: Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE): VML's Concession ends 2032-12-31, inside the ten years, the gaming assets already reverted to the Macao government without compensation, the next tender's terms unknowable, and mainland policy cut revenue from US$9,505M (2014) to US$6,820M (2015) and to US$1,605M (2022). After the stop, not weighed: the highest Macao margin of the four SEC-reporting operators, share 41.3% to 37.1% 2019 to 2025, dividends above profit 2016 to 2019, US$6.4bn of borrowings, the LVS royalty and an open AAEC claim. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: value HK$0.55 to 8.37 at the 5.56% Treasury against HK$11.29, no case earning the floor, fair HK$0.27 all-equity, HK$3.52 equity-only, not armed. Killed mid-run on 2026-10-14 and resumed by the overnight cycle 2026-10-15. Framework gaps for the operator: a right to earn ending inside ten years; Q7 (a) against (b); the width test's basis; time-limited tax exemptions; IFRS 16 leases in net debt; the earnings currency of a pegged reporter; accessions for a non-SEC name.
